content.text: Right now we are tracking the token usage for every checkpoint created as well as the last TranscriptUUIDAtStart and TranscriptLinesAtStart. It seems to work all right only if auto-commit strategy is selected.
I'll explore the codebase to understand how token usage tracking works and why it might only be working with the auto-commit strategy.

input.prompt:
Explore how token usage tracking is implemented in checkpoints. Focus on:
1. The checkpoint.go file and the TranscriptLinesAtStart and TranscriptUUIDAtStart fields
2. How token usage is stored and retrieved
3. How both manual-commit and auto-commit strategies save checkpoints

Look for any differences in how these strategies handle the token usage fields. Search for "TokenUsage", "TranscriptLinesAtStart", "TranscriptUUIDAtStart" across the codebase.
